title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-06-06
lineage: SBD Reel master > cassette > DAT > CD > SHN

ai_review.summary: Solid sound‑board tape with occasional cuts, featuring a stellar Dancing in the Street jam, fiery Alligator/Drums/Lovelight sequence and soaring Morning Dew.
ai_review.review: The recording is a vintage sound‑board source that retains surprising clarity despite its age and a few audible cuts. Musically the show shines – the early “Morning Dew” opener, a smoking “Dancing in the Street”, the haunting Darkness jam after Alligator, and the seamless Love > NFA > Love transition make it a favorite among 1970 summer shows.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4‑5 stars and praise the performance; recording is good with minor flaws, yielding a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally sharp for a 34‑year‑old tape; a few cuts and missing acoustic set sections, but overall clear and listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows beautifully with classic 1970 segues – Alligator into drums, a tight Love‑NFA‑Love transition, and a powerful second‑set jam sequence that keeps the energy high throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers laud his lead guitar – soaring solos on Morning Dew, a fiery China>Rider jam and crisp tone on New Orleans.
band_member_comments.Drums: The drummers receive high praise for tight, thunderous playing and an inspiring drum‑II section.
